finding: PR_5_FREE_BLOCK_COUNT and PR_5_FREE_INODE_COUNT carry PR_NO_OK. fix_problem does not unmark filesystem validity when an answer is no for those cases. Thus a readonly refusal can leave these mismatches printed while exit status remains0. pass5 corrects the respective superblock summary only when the fix is accepted.
limits: Explains this exit-status behavior; does not prove the origin of a mismatch or the state of the unavailable owner/current local seed. No production general repair is authorized by this receipt.
gate: The new output gate rejects every extra diagnostic line, including count mismatches/Fix? no, even with exit0. Native promotion additionally requires a fresh SCAN_CLEAN receipt bound to the new suffix.
